exposure: history of Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP)
outcome: placental migration in the third trimester
cohort: 200 pregnant women attending a tertiary care center underwent routine mid-trimester obstetric ultrasound.
finding: While 35% of pregnancies had a low-lying placenta in the mid-trimester, 60% of these migrated to a normal position by the third trimester, influenced by factors such as previous vaginal delivery, anterior placental location, and initial distance from the internal os.
mod_finding: Previous vaginal delivery was significantly associated with placental migration (85%), while previous Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS) hindered migration (61.5%).
